stage: prospective synthetic screening of sampling structure and finite-observation candidate ranking; not a new method or image benchmark
signal: 8-site real periodic zero-mean Gaussian field, DC=0, four nonnegative spectral parameters. Cosine/sine pair shares variance at k=1,2,3; Nyquist k=4 has one coefficient. Known total latent trace=8, an explicit synthetic family restriction.
observation: Point decimation by4: each phase observes sites phase and phase+4; duplicate frames have independent noise. Different phase sets differ in acquisition cost; only [0,0] versus [0,1] is measurement-count matched.
normalization: All spectral shapes scaled so 2*p1+2*p2+2*p3+p4=8; middle_spike raw=[0.1,3,0.1,0.8].
confidence_set: Zero mean is known. For e_i and e_i+/-e_j (m^2 directions), construct exact chi-square variance CIs using N degrees of freedom and Bonferroni alpha/m^2, alpha=.05 per case. Subtract known physical noise variance*direction_norm_squared. Intersect with p>=0 and known trace=8. Candidates fixed independently of these observations.
risk_interval: Full-target population squared risk of fixed linear GP candidate is affine in p. Dense LP computes all three pairwise gap lower/upper endpoints and retains feasible spectral witnesses; residual tolerance1e-7. Selection certifies a candidate only if every pairwise upper gap<=1e-8. Otherwise abstain; empty/failed sets explicit. This is classical partial identification/robust optimization, not claimed novel.
scope_of_guarantee: Confidence set covers the true synthetic covariance family with probability>=.95 per case. All fixed-arm gap intervals share this event. Certified selection concerns expected risk on a NEW independent realization; not adaptive loss on the covariance-estimation observations, not single-image conditional risk, not unknown or nonstationary natural-image PSD.
comparators: Fixed power2 and empirical Bayes marginal likelihood over three fixed candidates. These are diagnostic baselines here; no claim of matching the full real-image CV/GSURE benchmark. Population risk on the known true covariance scored only after all target selections are frozen.
exact_diagnostics: After selection freeze, compute exact observation covariance risk-gap intervals and covariance-map ranks. Rank expected2 for phases[0]/[0,0],4 for[0,1]/all. Also evaluate projected-target risk to distinguish visible risk from full-target risk. Spectral-nullspace directions alone need not reverse candidate ranks.
boundary: prepare writes observed samples and opaque case metadata separately from truth. select reads observed samples/protocol/fixed candidates only. Whole1920 selection records SHA-frozen before score reads truth. Exact covariance diagnostics are separate truth-based analyses, never used to tune this cohort.
claim_gates: Complete cohort and all LP witness residuals<=1e-7 before any numerical reliability statement. Empirical confidence coverage does not prove the theoretical family assumptions, and few/no false certificates does not certify a population error rate. Compare repeat/diverse phase effects descriptively with all counterexamples; no outcome-dependent case removal, no A-conference readiness claim.
failure: Absolute budget exhaustion saves incomplete without shortening cohort. Preserve numerical/coverage/certificate failures. Changed source requires new version/root; no silent continuation into frozen root.
next_stage: Use exact structural and finite-sample findings to decide whether there is a task-specific contribution beyond classical GSURE/partial-ID/robust design. Before GPU/image work freeze a new protocol and cohort, include calibrated-static/CV/applicable GSURE and marginal likelihood baselines, full costs and actual INR transfer. G2 target0813-0824 remains evaluation history.
novelty: Unestablished; general interval and abstention framework explicitly overlaps Montiel Olea/Qiu/Stoye arxiv2312.17623v3. Sampling-specific algebra is a candidate bridge, not automatically novel.
